description: This PHP source file defines the LanguageDao class, which handles data access operations related to Language entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and counting language records, as well as searching by name and IDs, with support for pagination and filtering.

classes.name: LanguageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Language entities, provides methods for CRUD operations and queries with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Persists a Language entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns an array of language IDs that exist in the database matching the provided IDs.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of Language entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object for paginated retrieval of Language entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Language entities matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language entities by their IDs, returns the number of records deleted.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks whether a language name already exists in the database.
